text:
Mia: Putting this thread up for Nexus + CloudMarket sync. They want private offers across Hosted/Dedicated and a joint announcement. Need commit bands, SKU plan, renewal mechanics, and caps on co-sell credits.

Ethan: I'll draft commit bands. Proposing 3 bands + a micro-pilot band for SI pilots. Will run numbers with finance later.

Sofia: Ops: confirm separate SKUs per deployment. Marketplace requires explicit SKU IDs for billing. Also need lead time for listing sync (~3 business days).

Lucas: Sales: define "co-sell credit" rules (what activity qualifies) and per-account max. Recommend per-account soft cap $35k, per-deal approval if >$20k.

Tara: Legal: credits expire 180 days, non-transferable, not cash-redeemable. Renewal language: automatic renewal unless opt-out 30 days before term end. Any auto-renew must be clear in PO.

Ethan: Draft bands:
Band Pilot - $5k pilot spend -> 0% discount + $2k pilot credit, 3mo term
Band Bronze - $40k commit -> 8% discount + $8k onboarding credit, 6mo term
Band Silver - $160k commit -> 16% discount + $20k onboarding credit, 12mo term
Band Gold - $480k+ commit -> 26% discount + $45k onboarding credit + priority queue, 12/24 term options

Lucas: Renewal incentive: renew early (within 30 days pre-expiry) -> additional 3% applied to next term. If commit increases >=25% -> extra 2% bonus.

Tara: Legal ok with those incentives. We'll add an explicit clause limiting onboarding/marketing credits to 30% of committed annual value and requiring exec sign-off above that.

Sofia: Ops note: priority queue for Gold requires Dedicated pool mapping and a capacity tag. That needs sku->pool mapping in the CSV we send marketplace.

Ethan: I'll cap co-sell credits at $35k/account and per-deal 30% of committed value. Approvals logged in Marketplace PR.

Mia: Announcement: Nexus wants joint page + press on launch day. Partner asks for 72-hr pre-notify; we keep 48 business-hr mutual review. No unilateral publishes.

partner-bot: Nexus comms draft posted: https://nexus.example/draft (requested 72-day pre-notice)

Tara: Also flag export control for on-prem appliance installs. PO template will include compliance flag checkbox.

Lucas: Field enablement: I'll produce 2 playbooks (SI qualification + renewal scripts) once bands are final.

Ethan: Action items: Ethan -> finance sensitivity + final bands; Tara -> PO clauses + renewal wording; Sofia -> SKU CSV template + listing ETA; Lucas -> enablement materials. Lock numbers by Wednesday EOD.

Mia: Good. If Nexus pushes longer legal review windows, escalate to me. Otherwise we'll finalize and push listing next Thursday.

All: +1

partner-bot: Reminder set: follow-up Wednesday 09:00 PT.
